is_anopheles.evidence: Studies field and laboratory populations of Anopheles gambiae, An. coluzzii, and An. arabiensis (Page 1, 3, 4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped Vgsc L995F (kdr-L995F) and Ace-1 G280S (ACE-1 G119S) using PCR assays (Page 3, 4, 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Reports kdr-L995F genotype counts/frequencies (LL, LF, FF) with exact sample sizes for survivors and dead mosquitoes of An. arabiensis, An. gambiae, and An. coluzzii in Figure 1B and text (Page 4, 5).

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquito larvae were collected in Tiefora, Burkina Faso, and Bahir Dar, Ethiopia, in July–August 2021 and reared to adults for bioassays and genotyping (Page 3, 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research study reporting original field collections, bioassays, target-site genotyping, 16S microbiome sequencing, and transcriptomics.

sub_country_location.evidence: Tiefora (10.62411667, -4.55335) in Burkina Faso and Bahir Dar (11.588790, 37.3888119) in Ethiopia (Page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collections were carried out from 7 July to 2 August 2021 in Burkina Faso and 28 July to 6 August 2021 in Ethiopia (Page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original field sampling and primary genotyping conducted in 2021 by the authors.

supplement.evidence: Genotype proportions and sample sizes for kdr-L995F across species and bioassay phenotypes are fully presented in Figure 1B and text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated pyrethroid (deltamethrin) resistance, Vgsc L995F and Ace-1 G119S marker frequencies, microbiota composition, and transcriptomic profiles in field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, An. arabiensis) from Burkina Faso and Ethiopia in 2021. Genotype frequencies of kdr-L995F were reported for alive and dead mosquitoes post-bioassay exposure.
